text:
sarah_sales: Heads up — Medexa POC orderform stuck. They want Net45, an HSM addendum (EU keys), and multi-entity signer mapping. We sent a DocuSign envelope and it errored on the second entity signer. Need quick routing/fallbacks so POC can start this week. PO attached.
esign-bot: automated system msg: envelope 0a1b2c validation failed for role mapping
```
ERROR: Signer 2: email != expected_id (550a4...). Validation code: MISMATCH_ROLE_EMAIL
Trace: /api/v2/envelopes/validate
```
sarah_sales: @sam_procurement @jess_legal any quick path? :eyes:
sam_procurement: Can we accept a PO instead of esign if it's faster? finance needs PO# and GL code anyway. If Medexa can send a PO, we can start provisioning while legal finalizes addendum.
jess_legal: I can draft an HSM addendum + DPA appendix. If DocuSign keeps failing we can do two options: 1) two separate envelopes (one per legal entity) and link via the orderform, or 2) wet-ink for the slower signer. Option 1 is fastest but need explicit cross-ref language in the orderform. :+1:
matt_engineer: From presales side — DocuSign failure usually means the role/email didn't match the identity provider claim. For the POC we can: send embedded signing link (less strict), or create separate envelopes per entity as Jess suggested. Also we can provision scoped API keys for subaccounts so they can use POC without waiting on final signature.
ben_accounting: Net45 is ok but finance needs the PO number, billing contact, and a line-item showing HSM surcharge. Confirming internal policy — HSM-backed key usage is +15% on top of base infra for dedicated keys. Will that be accepted by Medexa?
sarah_sales: Medexa said they'll accept a visible HSM fee if it's itemized. @jess_legal can you get the addendum draft within 24h? We need to show an invoice example to the customer.
jess_legal: I will draft the HSM addendum and a short clause for the orderform. ETA 24h. If we do separate envelopes, include text in orderform: "This OrderForm references the MSA executed by Entity A and Entity B (see attached envelopes)." Keep it simple.
sam_procurement: If we do separate envelopes, accounting needs both envelope IDs on the invoice, or a single invoice referencing both POs. @ben_accounting can you confirm acceptable format?
ben_accounting: We can combine into one invoice. Need both envelope IDs or both PO numbers referenced. Also need billing contact + remit address. Once we have PO# we'll queue Net45 terms.
matt_engineer: Quick tip — if you need to resend via CLI with proper role mapping, use our snippet: 
```
docusign-cli envelopes create --template-id tpl_abc123 \ 
  --roles '[{"roleName":"EntityA_Signer","email":"alice@entitya.com"},{"roleName":"EntityB_Signer","email":"bob@entityb.com"}]' 
```
That fixed the mismatch in recent customers.
eli_support: Happy to help re-generate envelope if you send the correct emails. I can also test embedded signing flow.
sarah_sales: I'll try resending envelope with corrected mapping now and ask Medexa for PO in parallel. @jess_legal please send draft to procurement@medexa.com and cc accounting@redwood.com. @ben_accounting hold on invoicing until I confirm both envelopes are accepted.
jess_legal: Draft will be sent shortly. If they push back on two envelopes, fallback is to have an MSA signed by primary entity and a simple consent letter from secondary entity — less legal friction for POC.
ben_accounting: Note: include HSM fee as separate line: "HSM key management (monthly)" — finance needs that text for their approvals.
sarah_sales: Ok plan: 1) resend envelope with proper role mapping, 2) request PO from Medexa, 3) Jess sends HSM addendum draft, 4) Matt/eli stand by to reprovision POC. Target: get POC running by EOW. :rocket:
sam_procurement: If no PO in 48h, we'll escalate to account exec. I'll monitor.
jess_legal: Confirmed — sending now (ETA ~6-12h to outbound). Will mark for priority review.
eli_support: I'll queue a test on staging once Sarah confirms resend. Keep me posted.
sarah_sales: Thanks team. I'll update thread after resend.
